params.1273: Given by Rat Burgiss south of Varrock for completing all Easy Tasks in Varrock.
params.1292: Varrock armour 1 and a magic lamp worth 1,000xp in a skill of your choice.
params.1274: The armour gives the following benefits:
params.1275: - Chance of smelting two bars at once up to steel at Edgeville's furnace.
params.1276: - Chance of mining two ores at once up to coal.
params.1277: - Improved chance of receiving a skull sceptre piece in the Stronghold of Security.
params.1278: You may also talk to Rat to change your Varrock Teleport destination to the Grand Exchange.
params.1279: Naff will sell up to 16 battlestaves a day.
